edges.notes: systemd-sysext and systemd-sysext.service are part of the systemd suite on Linux.
Extensions can ship unit files under merged hierarchies interpreted by systemd after merge.
Both are systemd-native ways to layer additional OS-tree content; portable services vs sysext merge differ in workflow and manuals.
Overlay-based merge relies on Linux mount and overlay filesystem support per systemd documentation.
Some boot/initrd flows document or deploy sysext alongside UKI-based systemd-centric images (distro-specific).
Host /usr merge vs OCI container delivery address overlapping 'ship extra software' goals with different isolation and tooling.
OCI image layers target container runtimes; sysext targets systemd-managed host hierarchy merge.
Confext is the sibling extension merge path for configuration trees alongside sysext for system hierarchies.
